title: gpu_inference.gpu_impairment
description: A GPU container instance was marked IMPAIRED by Amazon ECS. Normalized from the 'ECS Container Instance Health Change' EventBridge event and enriched, before auto-repair replaces the instance, with the tasks running on it (forensic capture).

gpu.impairment.cause.description: 'xid' when statusReason is XID_<n>. 'other' covers non-XID impairments ECS documents, such as an NVIDIA MPS daemon failure.

gpu.xid.code.description: Parsed from statusReason (XID_79 -> 79). Required when cause is 'xid'.

gpu.index.description: GPU index on the host, when known (the ECS event does not carry it; DCGM does).

gpu.health_check.status_reason.description: Raw healthChecks[].statusReason from the ECS event, kept verbatim.

forensics.captured_at.description: When task identifiers were read from the impaired instance.

forensics.task_arns.description: Tasks running on the instance at capture time (ListTasks by containerInstance). May be empty, but must be present: an absent list means capture was skipped.

remediation.auto_repair_enabled.description: autoRepairConfiguration.actionsStatus == ENABLED on the capacity provider at capture time.

source.event_id.description: EventBridge event 'id' this record was normalized from.
